units.source_text: 天色渐明，薰中纳言于晓雾迷离、晨光正美之时来到二条院。

en.t: As the sky began to grow light, the Middle Counselor Kaoru came to Nijo-in in the lovely hour of drifting dawn mist and morning light.

units.source_text: 室中都是女人，还在放怀睡觉。

en.t: Inside the rooms were only women, still sleeping without a care.

units.source_text: 他想：“此时敲格子门或边门，或者扬声咳嗽，似嫌唐突。

en.t: He thought, "If I knock on the lattice shutters or the side door now, or clear my throat loudly, it will seem rather abrupt.

units.source_text: 今天来得太早了。”

en.t: I have come much too early today."

units.source_text: 便召唤随从人，叫他们向中门内探望一下。

en.t: So he called his attendants and told them to look inside through the middle gate.

units.source_text: 随从人回来说：“格子窗都已掀开，侍女们似乎已在走动。”

en.t: The attendants returned and said, "The lattice shutters have all been raised, and the ladies-in-waiting seem to be moving about already."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言便下车，靠朝雾障身，从容移步而入。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru then got down from his carriage and, using the morning mist to conceal himself, walked in calmly.

units.source_text: 众侍女以为是匂亲王偷访情妇归来，闻到那种特殊的香气夹着雾气飘进来，方知是薰中纳言。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting thought Prince Niou had returned from a secret visit to a lover, but when that distinctive fragrance drifted in with the mist, they realized it was the Middle Counselor Kaoru.

units.source_text: 几个青年侍女就肆无忌惮地评论：“这位中纳言大人果然生得漂亮，只是过分一本正经，有些儿讨厌。”

en.t: Several young ladies-in-waiting commented without restraint, "This Lord Middle Counselor really is handsome, but he is far too serious, which is a little annoying."

units.source_text: 但她们不慌不忙，从容不迫地送出坐垫来，很有礼貌。

en.t: Even so, they did not hurry or fluster, but calmly brought out a cushion with perfect courtesy.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“准许我坐在这里，已蒙当作客人看待，不胜喜慰。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru said, "Being allowed to sit here and being treated as a guest gives me great pleasure.

units.source_text: 然而如此疏远地放我在帘外，我心终觉不快，今后不敢常来访问了。”

en.t: Yet if you keep me so distant, outside the blinds, I cannot help feeling displeased, and in future I shall hardly dare to visit often."

units.source_text: 侍女答道：“然则尊意如何？”

en.t: A lady-in-waiting replied, "Then what would you wish us to do?"

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“像我这样的熟客人，应该到北面幽静之处去休息。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru said, "A familiar guest like me ought to rest in some quiet place on the north side.

units.source_text: 但也听凭主人做主，不敢叫怨。”

en.t: But I leave it entirely to my host and would not presume to complain."

units.source_text: 说罢，他靠在门槛上了。

en.t: Having said this, he leaned against the threshold.

units.source_text: 众侍女便劝请二女公子：“还得小姐出去才是。”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting then urged the Second Princess, "You really must go out to him, my lady."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言本来不是一个雄赳赳气昂昂的人，加之近来更加斯文一脉，因此二女公子觉得现在和他直接谈话，羞涩之感渐渐减少，很习惯了。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru had never been a forceful, swaggering sort of man, and lately he had grown even more gentle, so the Second Princess now felt less and less shy about speaking with him directly and had become quite used to it.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看见二女公子面有病容，便问：“近来贵体如何？”

en.t: Seeing that the Second Princess looked ill, the Middle Counselor Kaoru asked, "How has your health been recently?"

units.source_text: 二女公子并无确切答复，只是神态比往常更加消沉。

en.t: The Second Princess gave no clear answer, and only seemed even more dejected than usual.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言很可怜她，便像兄妹一般详细教导她种种人情世故，又多方安慰她。

en.t: The Middle Counselor Kaoru felt deeply sorry for her, and like an elder brother, he explained many matters of the world to her in detail and comforted her in every way he could.

units.source_text: 二女公子的声音异常肖似乃姐，肖似得奇怪，竟像大女公子本人。

en.t: The Second Princess's voice resembled her elder sister's to an extraordinary degree, so strangely alike that it seemed to be the Elder Princess herself.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言如果不怕旁人讥议，很想揭起帘子，走进去和她对面，仔细看看她那忧愁的容颜。

en.t: If he had not feared people's criticism, the Middle Counselor Kaoru would have liked to lift the blinds, go inside, face her directly, and look closely at her sorrowful face.

units.source_text: 他此时恍然省悟：世间无愁的人恐怕是没有的吧。

en.t: At that moment he suddenly understood that there was probably no one in the world free from sorrow.

units.source_text: 便对二女公子说道：“我自己相信：虽不能像别人那样享受荣华富贵，却很可无忧无虑、明哲保身地度送一世。

en.t: He then said to the Second Princess, "I used to believe that although I could not enjoy wealth and glory as others do, I could pass my life free from anxiety, keeping wisely out of harm's way.

units.source_text: 然而由于自心作祟，遭逢了悲痛之事。

en.t: Yet because my own heart worked against me, I encountered a matter of deep sorrow.

units.source_text: 又由于自心愚笨，受尽了后悔之苦，弄得万念俱灰，心无宁日。

en.t: And because my own heart was foolish, I suffered every torment of regret, until all hope was ashes and my mind knew no peace.

units.source_text: 实在太无聊了！

en.t: It is truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 别人重视升官发财，因而忧愁悲叹，原是理之当然。

en.t: When others value promotion and wealth and grieve and lament over them, that is only natural.

units.source_text: 比较起他们来，我的忧愁悲叹实在是罪孽深重的啊！”

en.t: Compared with them, my own grief and lamentation are truly sinful indeed!"

units.source_text: 说着，把刚才摘得的朝颜花放在扇子上观赏，但见花瓣渐渐变红，色彩反而更美，便将花塞入帘内，赠二女公子一诗：

en.t: As he spoke, he placed the morning glory he had just picked on his fan and gazed at it; seeing the petals gradually turn red and their color grow all the more beautiful, he slipped the flower inside the blinds and offered the Second Princess a poem:
